measurements.evidence_quote: Dynamic light scattering (DLS) was used to determine the average particle size and the zeta potential of samples, typically 100× diluted in Millipore water using a Zetasizer Nano-ZS (Malvern Instruments, Malvern, United Kingdom). The DLS analyses were done in triplicate and the average was reported (Table S2).
measurements.evidence_location: Methods, Particle characterization; values in Table S2
